method: Parsed the two serialized InventorySkinsBuildData MonoBehaviours from resources.assets; nested List fields are read from Unity raw serialization and verified to consume each full object byte range.

interpretation.listed_in_gate_map: This exact catalog item is explicitly associated with a recovered inventory flag.
interpretation.not_listed_in_recovered_maps: No exact item-name match in the recovered tables; this is not proof the item is free.
interpretation.coverage: The table gives pack flags and skin names. UI category integer mapping is not serialized in these two objects; skin_family is derived from the skin-name prefix.
